import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def comps_of(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop(); c.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and I[a][b] and not seen[a][b]:
                            seen[a][b]=True; st.append((a,b))
                res.append(c)
    return res
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    cs=comps_of(I)
    bar=[c for c in cs if len(set(I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c))>=2][0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in bar]; cc=[p[1] for p in bar]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)
    if r1>r0:   # vertical strip: legend read top-to-bottom
        bcols=[I[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    else:       # horizontal strip: legend read left-to-right
        bcols=[I[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
    barset=set(bar)
    objects=[c for c in cs if c not in [bar] and all(p not in barset for p in c)]
    # stamps computed from ORIGINAL input colors; draw into out from bottom-most object upward to avoid collisions
    draws=[]
    for obj in objects:
        col=I[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
        si=bcols.index(col)
        h=max(i for i,_ in obj)-min(i for i,_ in obj)+1
        w=max(j for _,j in obj)-min(j for _,j in obj)+1
        # stamp above = slot si-1 (prev legend color), stamp below = slot si+1
        for di,dr,sh in [(si-1,-1,-h),(si+1,+1,0)]:
            if 0<=di<len(bcols):
                nc=bcols[di]
                if dr==-1: sh=-h
                top=min(i for i,_ in obj)+sh
                bottom=max(i for i,_ in obj)+sh
                if 0<=top<0 or True: pass
                # check target region fits & is free of other objects/bar
                ok=True
                for i,j in obj:
                    a=i+sh
                    if not (0<=a<H) or (out[a][j]!=0 and (i,a) not in set(obj) and not any(p==a+j for p in [])):
                        pass
                draws.append((nc,dr,obj,sh,top))
    # simpler direct approach: draw all stamps onto a copy, resolving: draw lower ones first so upper don't overwrite?
    # in demos stamps never overlap objects. Just do sequential: for each object draw above then below, drawing 'below' stamps last for later objects.
    for obj in sorted(objects,key=lambda o:min(i for i,_ in o),reverse=True):
        col=I[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
        si=bcols.index(col)
        h=max(i for i,_ in obj)-min(i for i,_ in obj)+1
        for di,ddir in [(si-1,'up'),(si+1,'down')]:
            if not(0<=di<len(bcols)): continue
            nc=bcols[di]
            if ddir=='up':
                sh=-h
            else:
                sh=max(i for i,_ in obj)+1
            for i,j in obj:
                a=i+sh
                if 0<=a<H and out[a][j]==0:
                    out[a][j]=nc
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    cs=comps_of(I)
    bar=[c for c in cs if len(set(I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c))>=2][0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in bar]; cc=[p[1] for p in bar]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)
    if r1>r0:
        bcols=[I[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    else:
        bcols=[I[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
    barset=set(bar)
    # group non-bar cells by contiguous single-color region (objects may touch each other)
    # split comp into sub-components by same color
    objcells=[(i,j) for c in cs for (i,j) in c if (i,j) not in barset]
    objcells.sort()
    objs=[]; rem=set(objcells)
    while rem:
        start=next(iter(rem))
        stack=[start]; sub=set([start]); rem.discard(start)
        while stack:
            x,y=stack.pop()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                if (a,b) in rem and I[a][b]==I[start]:
                    rem.discard((a,b)); stack.append((a,b)); sub.add((a,b))
        objs.append(sorted(sub))
    for obj in objs:
        col=I[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
        si=bcols.index(col)
        t0=min(i for i,_ in obj); t1=max(i for i,_ in obj)
        h=t1-t0+1
        for di,ddir in [(si-1,'up'),(si+1,'down')]:

            for i,j in obj:
                a=i+sh
                if 0<=a<H and out[a][j]==0:
                    out[a][j]=nc
    for p in bar: out[p[0]][p[1]]=0
    return out

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    cs=comps_of(I)
    bar=[c for c in cs if len(set(I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c))>=2][0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in bar]; cc=[p[1] for p in bar]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)
    # legend: read along the axis perpendicular... decide by which line has >=2 distinct colors
    if len({I[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)})>=2:
        bcols=[I[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]   # horizontal bar: left-to-right
    else:
        bcols=[I[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]   # vertical bar: top-to-bottom
    barset=set(bar)
    objcells=[(i,j) for c in cs for (i,j) in c if (i,j) not in barset]
    objs=[]; rem=set(objcells)
    while rem:
        start=next(iter(rem))
        stack=[start]; sub=set([start]); rem.discard(start)
        while stack:
            x,y=stack.pop()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                if (a,b) in rem and I[a][b]==I[start[0]][start[1]]:
                    rem.discard((a,b)); stack.append((a,b)); sub.add((a,b))
        objs.append(sorted(sub))
    # draw stamps only onto zero cells, resolve collisions by drawing lower stamps first
    draws=[]
    for obj in objs:
        col=I[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
        si=bcols.index(col)
        t0=min(i for i,_ in obj); t1=max(i for i,_ in obj)
        h=t1-t0+1
        for di in (si-1,si+1):
            if 0<=di<len(bcols):
                draws.append((obj,nc:=bcols[di],-h if di==si-1 else t1+1))
    # paint bottom-most stamps first so higher ones don't cover them
    draws.sort(key=lambda d:-d[2] if d[2]>0 else -(d[2]))
    for obj,nc,sh in draws:
        for i,j in obj:
            a=i+sh
            if 0<=a<H and out[a][j]==0:
                out[a][j]=nc
    for p in bar: out[p[0]][p[1]]=0
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps_of(g)
    bar=min(cs,key=lambda c:len(c[1]))
    _,bc=bar; bset=set(bc)
    if len({p[1] for p in bc})==1:   # vertical bar -> seq down column
        col0=min(p[1] for p in bc)
        seq=[g[r][col0] for r in range(H)]; n=len(seq); axis='v'
    else:                             # horizontal bar -> seq across row
        row0=min(p[0] for p in bc)
        seq=[g[row0][c] for c in range(W)]; n=len(seq); axis='h'
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for col,cells in cs:
        if (col,cells)==bar: continue
        k=seq.index(col)
        minr=min(p[0] for p in cells); maxr=max(p[0] for p in cells)
        minc=min(p[1] for p in cells); maxc=max(p[1] for p in cells)
        rel=[(r-minr,c) for r,c in cells]
        h=maxr-minr+1; w=maxc-minc+1
        if axis=='v':
            top = minr-h-1
            bot = maxr+h+1
            if top>=0 and k>0:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[top+rr][cc]=seq[k-1]
            if bot<H and k<n-1:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[bot+rr][cc]=seq[k+1]
        else:
            left = minc-w-1
            right = maxc+w+1
            if left>=0 and k>0:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[rr][left+cc]=seq[k-1]
            if right<W and k<n-1:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[rr][right+cc]=seq[k+1]
    for r,c in bset: out[r][c]=0
    return out

        res=solve(gi)
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(res,go)):

    _,bc=bar; bset=set(bc)
    if len({p[1] for p in bc})==1:   # vertical bar
        col0=min(p[1] for p in bc)
        seq=[g[r][col0] for r in range(H)]; axis='v'

        row0=min(p[0] for p in bc)
        seq=[g[row0][c] for c in range(W)]; axis='h'
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for col,cells in cs:

        try: k=seq.index(col)

        minr=min(p[0] for p in cells); maxr=max(p[0] for p in cells)

G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps_of(g)
    bar=min(cs,key=lambda c:len(c[1]))
    _,bc=bar; bset=set(bc)
    if len({p[1] for p in bc})==1:   # vertical bar: seq down column
        col0=min(p[1] for p in bc)
        seq=[g[r][col0] for r in range(len(g))]; n=len(seq); axis='v'
    else:                           # horizontal bar: seq across row
        row0=min(p[0] for p in bc)
        seq=[g[row0][c] for c in range(len(g[0]))]; n=len(seq); axis='h'
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for col,cells in cs:
        if (col,cells)==bar: continue
        try: k=seq.index(col)
        except ValueError: continue
        minr=min(p[0] for p in cells); maxr=max(p[0] for p in cells)
        minc=min(p[1] for p in cells); maxc=max(p[1] for p in cells)
        rel=[(r-minr,c) for r,c in cells]
        h=maxr-minr+1; w=maxc-minc+1
        if axis=='v':
            top=minr-h-1; bot=maxr+h+1
            if top>=0 and k>0:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[top+rr][cc]=seq[k-1]
            if bot<H and k<n-1:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[bot+rr][cc]=seq[k+1]
        else:
            left=minc-w-1; right=maxc+w+1
            if left>=0 and k>0:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[rr][left+cc]=seq[k-1]
            if right<W and k<n-1:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[rr][right+cc]=seq[k+1]
    for r,c in bset: out[r][c]=0
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

    ok=solve(gi)==go

        res=solve(gi)
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(res,go)):
            if a!=b:
                print('row',i)
                print('\n'.join(map(str,a)))
                print('--')
                print('\n'.join(map(str,b)))

G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    parts=comps_of(g)   # list of (cells, {color})
    bar=min(parts,key=lambda p:len(p[1]))[1] if False else None
    # bar: the component with multiple colors
    bpart=[p for p in parts if len(p[1])>1][0]
    bcells,bcol=bpart
    bset=set(bcol)
    row0=min(p[0] for p in bcells); col0=min(p[1] for p in bcells)
    if len(bcells)==1:
        seq=[g[r][col0] for r in range(H)]; axis='v'
    else:
        seq=[g[row0][c] for c in range(W)]; axis='h'
    n=len(seq)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cl,cset in parts:
        if cl==bcells or len(cset)!=1: continue
        col_=next(iter(cset))
        k=seq.index(col_)
        minr=min(p[0] for p in cl); maxr=max(p[0] for p in cl)
        minc=min(p[1] for p in cl); maxc=min(p[1] for p in cl)+max(p[1]-minc for p in []) 
        w=max(max(c-minc for c,_ in cl)+1, 1)
        h=max(max(r-minr for r,_ in cl)+1, 1)
        rel=[(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cl]
        if axis=='v':
            top=minr-h-1; bot=maxr+h+1
            if top>=0 and k>0:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[top+rr][cc]=seq[k-1]
            if bot<H and k<n-1:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[bot+rr][cc]=seq[k+1]
        else:
            left=minc-w-1; right=maxc+w+1
            if left>=0 and k>0:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[rr][left+cc]=seq[k-1]
            if right<W and k<n-1:
                for rr,cc in rel: out[rr][right+cc]=seq[k+1]
    for r,c in bcells: out[r][c]=0
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    ok=solve(gi)==go
    print(k,'match:',ok)
    if not ok:
        res=solve(gi)
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(res,go)):
            if a!=b:
                print('row',i)
                print('\n'.join(map(str,a)))
                print('--')
                print('\n'.join(map(str,b)))

def solve(g):

    bcells,bcol=bpart
    bset=set(bcol)
    row0=min(p[0] for p in bcells); col0=min(p[1] for p in bcells)
    if len(bcells)==1:        # vertical bar: single column, colors vary by row
        seq=[g[r][col0] for r in range(H)]; axis='v'
    else:                     # horizontal bar: single row
        seq=[g[row0][c] for c in range(W)]; axis='h'
    n=len(seq)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cl,cset in parts:
        if cl==bcells or len(cset)!=1: continue

        minc=min(p[1] for p in cl); maxcc=max(p[1] for p in cl)
        w=maxcc-minc+1; h=maxr-minr+1
        rel=[(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cl]
        if axis=='v':
            top=minr-h-1   # one empty row above object

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    parts=comps_of(g)
    bar=None
    for p in parts:
        cs=set(p[1])
        if len(cs)>1: bar=p
    bcells,bcol=bar
    row0=min(p[0] for p in bcells); col0=min(p[1] for p in bcells)
    horiz=all(r==row0 for r,_ in bcells)   # bar runs horizontally -> seq along columns, objects below
    vert = all(c==col0 for _,c in bcells)
    seq=( [g[r][col0] for r in range(H)] if vert else [g[row0][c] for c in range(W)] )
    n=len(seq)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def can(r0,c0,cl):
        return all(0<=r0+rr<H and 0<=c0+cc<W and out[r0+rr][c0+cc]==0 for rr,cc in cl)
    def stamp(r0,c0,rel,col):
        for rr,cc in rel: out[r0+rr][c0+cc]=col
    for cl,cs in parts:
        if cl==bcells: continue
        col_=next(iter(cs)); k=seq.index(col_)
        if vert:  # seq down rows; objects sit beside bar column
            # direction along bar axis = vertical here? no: demo2 bar vertical, seq down rows; objects to the right
            minr=min(p[0] for p in cl); maxr=max(p[0] for p in cl)
            minc=min(p[1] for p in cl); maxc=max(p[1] for p in cl)
            w=maxc-minc+1; h=maxr-minr+1
            rel=[(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cl]
            # bar occupies rows 0..n-1 at col0; objects to the right at various rows
            if k>0:   # stamp above the object: rows minr-h .. minr-1, cols minc..maxc
                pass
            # actually expected: stamp in prev slot goes UPWARD (higher rows)
            if k>0 and can(minr-h,minc,rel):
                stamp(minr-h,minc,rel,seq[k-1])
            if k<n-1 and can(minr+h,minc,rel):
                stamp(minr+h,minc,rel,seq[k+1])
        else:      # demo1: bar horizontal (rows 0..h-1, cols 0..2); seq left->right; objects BELOW bar
            minr=min(p[0] for p in cl); maxr=max(p[0] for p in cl)
            minc=min(p[1] for p in cl); maxc=max(p[1] for p in cl)
            h=maxr-minr+1; w=maxc-minc+1
            rel=[(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cl]
            if k>0 and can(minr-h,minc,rel):
                stamp(minr-h,minc,rel,seq[k-1])
            if k<n-1 and can(minr+h,minc,rel):
                stamp(minr+h,minc,rel,seq[k+1])
    for r,c in bcells: out[r][c]=0
    return out
